holderPosition.legalForm: Non-voting participating share of BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd., a BVI private fund, in a Solana share class whose supplement was not reviewed; Securitize keeps the issuer books as transfer agent and registrar
holderPosition.says: The holder is a shareholder of the BVI fund, recorded in the issuer books that Securitize keeps; the transfer-agent agreement says the tokens authenticate ownership and transfers. The holder has no vote and no direct claim on the fund's Treasury bills, repos or cash, and the redemption and insolvency terms sit in a confidential offering memorandum that was not reviewed.

tokens.note: Research records this as the official Solana class address; the older catalogue lists the token standard as SPL, but the chain read shows Token-2022.
The fund launched on Ethereum (announcement of 20 March 2024); the older catalogue says it moves cross-chain through Wormhole NTT. Research recorded only the Solana deployment row.

chainFacts.says: Token-2022 mint, 6 decimals, supply 931,061,169.15 BUIDL on Solana.

One address, APm3MWbXfMMKAWgsDVnxcAGbLjvRxubPu1A8a5SA2kbJ, is mint authority, freeze authority, permanent delegate (move or burn any balance), transfer-hook authority, metadata authority and mint-close authority. The transfer hook runs program FsE8mCJyvgMzqJbfHbJQm3iuf3cRZC6n2vZi1Q8rQCy2. Who holds the key is not in the sources.
The older catalogue recorded 993,191,100 BUIDL on the Solana leg and $2.68B fund AUM on 16 September 2026; supply on one chain is not the fund's share count.

outside.says: Redemption follows the confidential offering memorandum and the class terms; the timetable, minimum and fees were not established. Stays in the fund documents and Securitize's onboarding.
The registrar may reject improper transfers, require documents and implement stop-transfer notices; the chain shows a permanent delegate and freeze authority that can carry them out.
The older catalogue says the fund distributes dividends daily and moves between chains through Wormhole NTT; research did not review the class distribution terms or the bridge.
Investor recovery and priority between share classes under BVI law were not established from the public agreement.

verdict.summary: A registered fund share with a transfer-agent register, a custodian and an administrator can be outlined in v3. But the token is Token-2022, so it cannot be read; ownership-interest hides that the holder is a registered shareholder; nothing can say whether the books or the chain prevail; and the NAV has no basis. Securitize publishes the most, while BNY Mellon, the auditor and the fund itself publish nothing about this token in their own name.
